senses.sense_definition: A group of stars forming a recognizable pattern in the sky, often named after mythological figures.

examples.text: The astronomer pointed out the <w>constellation</w> of Orion in the night sky.
Many ancient cultures created stories about each <w>constellation</w> they saw above.

senses.sense_definition: A collection or grouping of related things or ideas.

examples.text: The project involves a <w>constellation</w> of different factors that must be managed carefully.
She faced a <w>constellation</w> of challenges while trying to launch her new business.

senses.sense_definition: A group of artificial satellites working together to provide a specific service.

examples.text: The company launched a new <w>constellation</w> of satellites to improve global internet access.
Managing a <w>constellation</w> of satellites requires precise coordination from ground control.

senses.sense_definition: A scattered collection of marks or small items on a surface.

examples.text: He had a <w>constellation</w> of freckles across his nose and cheeks.
The artist painted a <w>constellation</w> of tiny dots to create the background texture.

senses.sense_definition: A collection of repressed emotions or ideas that influence mental health.

examples.text: The therapist helped the patient identify a <w>constellation</w> of anxieties rooted in childhood.
His behavior was driven by a complex <w>constellation</w> of unresolved feelings.
